descriptor_definitions.spin_extent_ang2: sum |s_i| |r_i - CM|^2 / sum |s_i|, s = Mulliken spin population of the anion, CM = centre of mass
descriptor_definitions.chg_extent_ang2: same radius of second moment with the weights q_anion - q_neutral

descriptor_domain.note: Mulliken spin populations are normalised (signed sum = 1) but not positive, so max |s_i| > 1 is a signature of a strongly spin-polarised solution, not of an unbound anion. Layers whose spin polarisation exceeds 1.2x the molecule's own median are flagged because a different SCF solution was found there.
